intro: Keep timelines for the people in your life. Each Life has its own milestones and chapters, and a milestone can belong to more than one.
meNote: Me is always you: it can't be renamed or deleted. Its birthday is the one in Settings.
deathBeforeBirth: The date died can't be before the date born.
deleteOnly: {{count}} milestone(s) only {{name}} has will be deleted.
gateBody: Lives need every device that syncs this timeline to run lifeGLANCE 5.0 or later. These synced in the last 60 days with an older version:
gateLegacyDevice: A device on an older version
gateFooter: Once they are updated and have synced, you can add Lives here.
settingsNote: Timelines for the people in your life, alongside your own.
atLeastOneLife: A milestone needs at least one Life.
gateRestoreFooter: Once they are updated and have synced, you can restore this backup.
importIntro: Choose what to do with each Life in this file. Nothing changes until you import.
importMilestonesMerged: {{count}} milestone(s) you both have will be merged.
importMilestonesLeftOut: {{count}} milestone(s) only in skipped Lives will be left out.
importChapters: {{count}} chapter(s) will be added or merged.
gateImportFooter: Once they are updated and have synced, you can import this file.
shareIntro: Choose which Lives go in the file. Only their milestones, chapters and photos, and the relationships between them, are included.
restoreSharedFile: This file holds only some Lives. To add them, use Import and merge in Settings, under Lives.
chapterAtLeastOneLife: A chapter needs at least one Life.
chapterMembersLeave: {{count}} milestone(s) in none of these Lives will leave this chapter.
compareAtLeastTwo: Compare needs at least two Lives.
